def process_input_string(S: str) -> None:
    a_count = b_count = c_count = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(S)
    
    # Count consecutive 'A's
    while i < n and S[i] == 'A':
        a_count += 1
        i += 1
    
    # Count consecutive 'B's
    while i < n and S[i] == 'B':
        b_count += 1
        i += 1
    
    # Count consecutive 'C's
    while i < n and S[i] == 'C':
        c_count += 1
        i += 1
    
    # Check if all characters are used and counts are non-zero
    if i == n and a_count > 0 and b_count > 0 and c_count > 0:
        print('Yes')
    else:
        print('No')
